entries.description: Turns drawio XML into a deliverable that opens directly in a browser. Writes viewer HTML (.html; opening it redirects to draw.io) to out_path and, by default, also writes a rendered PNG (useful for checking the rendering). icon:// references are resolved to data URIs and embedded. Before generating, it checks the diagram labels against the text rules and generates nothing if there is a violation. The font and font size are checked against the theme declaration (theme, or the theme of the talk-dir that is an ancestor of the diagram), and the result is returned in theme.

entries.description: Downloads the runtime dependencies pecotv uses (@slidev/cli / dom-to-pptx / @slidev/parser, etc.) and Playwright Chromium. Call it when slide_create / slide_convert / slide_sync fail with "runtime dependencies are not installed", or when drawio_export / slide_convert / drawio_create PNG output fails with "Playwright Chromium is not installed". The first run downloads about 600MB of runtime dependencies and about 120MB of Chromium, so it takes tens of seconds. If OS libraries needed to launch Chromium are missing, it installs them with apt-get where sudo is available, and otherwise returns the command to install them. It skips what is already installed, so it finishes quickly and is safe to call repeatedly.

entries.description: Syncs an existing talk-dir. A pre-migration talk-dir (one that holds a copy of the template; slide_dev and others stop with theme-none) is moved to a form that references the theme given by `theme`. Files that came from the template are deleted, and the work area (slides.md / pages/*.md / public/slides/) is kept. The deleted names are returned in migration.removed. A migrated talk-dir that references a theme (theme: in slides.md points to the theme in dependencies of package.json) fetches the theme at the version in the dependency and relinks node_modules, and aligns the generated files (vite.config.ts, start.mjs) with the current content of the plugin. Other files are left unchanged. To raise the theme version, rewrite the #<tag> of the dependency in package.json before calling. Returns the presentation categories (categories), the list of selectable layouts (layouts), and the lint result of the whole deck after the sync. A running slide_dev must be stopped with stop: true and started again.

entries.description: Returns the theme declaration referenced by a talk-dir and the list of layouts. The declaration covers fonts, font sizes, PPTX fonts and link colors, and lint rules. Skills use it to obtain theme values.

dir.description: Absolute path of the talk-dir whose theme to inspect. Relative paths are not accepted. Windows-style paths (C:\... / \\wsl.localhost\<distro>\...) are accepted and converted to an absolute path under /mnt/<drive>/ or inside WSL.

categories.description: Presentation categories declared by the theme (success only)

id.description: Category ID that layouts[].category refers to

question.description: Question that tells when to choose the category

convertedPaths.description: Windows-style path arguments converted before the rejection, keyed by parameter name (failure only, kind invalid-path; omitted when nothing was converted)

declaration.description: Theme declaration with omitted items filled with defaults (success only)

panels.description: Panel size of the diagram per layout name

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

event.description: slide.theme.done on success, slide.theme.error on failure (omitted when a path argument is rejected)

invalidPaths.description: Rejected path arguments as <parameter>=<value> (failure only, kind invalid-path)

layouts.description: Selectable layouts (hidden layouts are excluded) (success only)

category.description: Category ID (uncategorized when unset or unknown)

deprecated.description: Whether the layout is deprecated (not to be chosen)

filename.description: File name of the reference yaml

lint.description: Input passed to the deck lint (success only)

markerLayouts.description: Layout names that have marker cells

panels.description: Panel size of the diagram per layout name

referencesDirectories.description: Directories searched for reference yaml, in priority order

log.description: Raw output of the command or child process (failure only). Over 64KB, the end is kept and the first line notes the truncation

directory.description: Absolute path of the theme root

linked.description: Whether the theme was found in node_modules directly under the talk-dir

spec.description: Theme specification in the dependencies of package.json

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run (omitted when there are none). Beyond 100 warnings or 64KB, the last item tells how many were omitted

entries.name: slide_theme
